routingNotes: Two ordered routes share /quiz. First entry uses canMatch=invitedQuizMatch and loads InvitedQuizComponent only when query parameter practice=invite; otherwise the later /quiz QuizPageComponent route handles it.

Learning Lab routes use labGuard: signed-in Firebase Auth is required; no app role check for lesson pages. /learning-lab/results and /learning-lab/plants/results set adminOnly and redirect non-admins or failed profile reads to /learning-lab.

Most learner routes use AuthGuard and RoleGuard with data.roles=['user','admin']; this includes /dashboard, /profile, quiz/live/run/reports routes. Direct unauthenticated redirects are implemented by guards; exact redirect destination should be confirmed with the emulator's AuthGuard fixture.
/profile-setup and /practice are deliberately public. No route alias was found beyond practice=invite selecting the first /quiz route and wildcard-to-home.

Legacy standalone files such as practice-return.component.ts, practice-share.component.ts and practice-summary.component.ts are not independent route paths. The invited quiz directly loads InvitedQuizComponent; those helper components are composed from invitation flow elsewhere. Only routed surfaces are capture targets.

unreachableSourceNotes: pages/practice-invite/practice-share.component.ts, practice-return.component.ts and practice-summary.component.ts are helper components, not direct route targets.

scripts/fixtures/learning-lab-preview.ts and plant-lab-preview.ts register test-only substitute routes/providers (including fallback-to-LearningLab); production app route configuration is app.routes.ts. Do not use the preview fixture URL map to infer production route reachability.

CurrentLab practice mode is reached in-page with 'Try without saving'; PlantLab practice mode via 'Explore without saving' in saved-progress details or 'Continue without saving' on save error. Neither is activated by a route/query flag.
dataAndUnknowns: The canonical invitation is declared in app/services/reviewed-practices.ts (CBSE Class 12, Chemistry / Solutions; five immutable IDs and SHA-256 content hashes). app.config.ts sets INVITED_SOLO_READY=true and supplies question-presentation adapters. Anonymous public preview needs only this manifest; the signed-in question route additionally needs users/{uid} matching board and standard (unless role=admin) and five emulator questions whose stored fields exactly match the manifest content hashes.

Live session pages are Firestore-backed at LiveSessions/{sessionId}; participant docs at LiveSessions/{sessionId}/participants/{uid}; answers at LiveSessions/{sessionId}/answers/{index}/items/{uid}. Session questionIds must reference seeded questions so fetchQuestionsForSession can render question text/options. For live mode, include hostId, hostName, joinCode, mode='live', scope, questionIds, scheduledStartAt (Firestore Timestamp), bufferSeconds, perQuestionSeconds, effectiveStartAt, autoAdvance, status ('lobby'|'active'|'ended'), overrideIndex/overrideAt, anchorIndex/anchorAt, startedAt, resultLinked. Participant records need uid, displayName, ready. For collaborative quiz run use mode='run', status='lobby', maxParticipants; hostId must equal fixture user's UID to show Start Quiz Run; include at least one participant so canStart is true.

Host console route has no role/host route guard; hostId affects controls indirectly through creation flow/service, so use admin host identity and fixture-created session for a coherent view. /live/play/:sessionId redirects run mode to the run lobby.

Live countdown exact state depends on scheduledStartAt/anchorAt relative to browser clock. Use future start + positive buffer for scheduled lobby; active state requires status active and anchor pair. session pages can redirect automatically as status updates.

Current app contains no explicit URL query feature flags for the labs. Admin feedback routes are data.adminOnly guarded by user document role, while lesson pages accept any authenticated identity; profile setup is not checked by labGuard but lab persistence requires a corresponding users/{uid} document.

There are e2e tests for invitation flow but no production route e2e for Live or Quiz Run in fetched E2E inventory; exact live session screenshot fixtures are therefore inferred from LiveQuizService and page component reads. Verify against emulator rules/seed harness before capture.
